messages:
erin: Heads-up: ran a console dry-run for the new quota-shard config and numbers look off. Preview count is 2.2k but extrapolated token estimate is tiny. Anyone seen token undercounting?

joel: I hit the same. Console shows Preview requests=2200 (sample=1%) and Tokens est=3.2k which doesn't match my expectations.

rachel: Is the console doing per-request sampling but not scaling tokens? We currently sample decision events and separately sample token measurements. If the sampling rates differ you get bad estimates.

owen: That matches. Runtime shadow path emits decision events at sample_rate=0.01 and token probes at sample_rate=0.001 for perf reasons. We need consistent sampling or a deterministic extrapolation formula.

erin: Can we standardize on sampling on the decision-level only and compute token estimate by multiplying avg_tokens_per_sample * extrapolated_requests? Simpler and cheaper.

joel: Proposal: telemetry should include sample_rate and sampled_count for both dimensions. Then console computes: extrapolated_requests = sampled_count / sample_rate; extrapolated_tokens = (sum_sampled_tokens / sampled_count) * extrapolated_requests. Add confidence interval using Wilson score for counts.

rachel: Sounds good. Two concerns: 1) avg_tokens can be skewed by outliers; need median and p90 too. 2) When sample_count is small (<30) CI is huge. Show a warning and mark estimates as unreliable.

owen: Implementation note: runtime will add these fields on preview telemetry: preview.sample_rate, preview.sampled_decisions, preview.sampled_tokens_sum, preview.sampled_tokens_p50, preview.sampled_tokens_p90, preview.cohort_id. All as tagged fields; no downstream change required.

erin: UX: console should display sampling rate prominently and show the extrapolation formula with an info tooltip. Also provide a toggle to "use token-probe pathway" which will increase token sampling but warn about perf.

joel: For API contract: when POST /v1/configs/apply?preview=true we return preview_id and preview.sample_rate in body. Example: {"preview_id":"pv_abc123", "sample_rate":0.01, "cohort_id":"c-2026-03-21"}.

rachel: minor nit: don't send nested JSON in examples in docs pages; show as code block in docs. But in telemetry schema the fields must be flat labels (strings/numbers).

erin: ops question: do we tag preview telemetry so dashboards don't accidentally mix? Use label preview=true + cohort hash.

owen: Yep will tag metrics with redwood.preview=preview and preview.cohort_hash. Also include config_hash to correlate across changes.

joel: Dashboards: default panels should filter out preview metrics. Add a small preview tile showing extrapolated estimates and a reliability badge (green/yellow/red) based on sample_count.

rachel: Also add an action button: "Promote sample to canary" that creates a small live cohort. That button should show an estimated quota delta and cost delta before confirming.

erin: Security/legal: ensure preview telemetry is marked non-billable. Add header X-Redwood-Dryrun: true that propagates to telemetry consumers.

telemetry-bot: NOTE: schema change requested. Fields proposed: preview.sample_rate, preview.sampled_decisions, preview.sampled_tokens_sum, preview.sampled_tokens_p50, preview.sampled_tokens_p90, preview.cohort_id, preview.cohort_hash, preview.config_hash. Telemetry-team to review.

opsbot: ACTION: owen to open runtime PR for sampling labels; joel to update console panels; rachel to add UI copy; erin to draft API example. ETA Thurs.

owen: Will open PR tonight with a spike enabling token probes behind `shadow.token_probe_enabled` and default sample_rate=0.01 for previews.

erin: Thanks. If we gate by org opt-in for the first week it reduces risk. We'll run a pilot with 2 customers.

joel: Agreed. Let's include a small playbook note for Ops: how to filter and delete preview metrics if they leak into production dashboards.

rachel: I'll add that to the PR description and docs.

erin: Great. We'll reconvene after PR review.
